5

6
➢ How do I read this sheet?

7
Team Compositions

8
➢ Teams are simply arranged based on Trekker release order.
➢ The first Trekker listed in each team composition is always considered the Main Slot Trekker.
➢ The second Trekker is usually the primary Support Slot Trekker.
➢ The remaining Trekkers are candidates for the final Support Slot, listed in order of their effectiveness for the team.
➢ Trekkers with universal buff effect will not be included unless they offer exceptional value as an alternative option. This is done to reduce the clutter with how much team compositions there are.

*Exception:
- Some team compositions require both Support Slot Trekkers as mandatory picks. In these cases, only the last listed Trekker is flexible and may be swapped out if they are needed for another team.

9
Main Discs

10
Main Disc priorities are determined by overall team utility with these specific Crescendo criteria in mind:

• C1 for Limited, Standard, and Finale Echoing Discs
• C6 for Cataclysm and Event Discs

About Support Discs
You will usually choose Discs that provide the highest relevant stat for the team. Of course, it is best if it also matches the note requirements of your Main Discs but only think of this when we have more Disc options.

Typically, the stats you are looking for are:
• Base ATK
• Elemental DMG%
• AA/Skill DMG%

11
Emblems

12
➢ All emblem affixes are based on the highest rarity.
➢ Emblem affixes with GREEN background indicate that they are the best emblem affix to go for in that slot.
➢ Affixes are ordered by priority from most important (top) to least important (bottom).
➢ Having an Elemental PEN stat of any rarity for your DPS is always better than having none, but do not lock PEN below Gold or Rainbow rarity.

13
Potentials

14
➢ The recommendations are based on maxed out Monolith Research and Ascension Difficulty 8.
➢ All Potentials are arranged based on acquisition and level upgrade priority.
➢ Level 1: Safe to not upgrade past the base level
➢ Level 1+: Upgrade the Potential as much as you can if possible
➢ Level 6: Always upgrade the Potential to its maximum level

*For specific questions, go to the #help-and-advice channel of Stella Sora Official server.

Cosette (4★) | 1/1/10/1 (Support Skill only)

44

Cosette is the staple support for any Umbra team at the moment due to the consistent high Umbra DMG Taken debuff and ATK% buffs that she is able to provide.

★ Key Notes:
• Phantom Mark is preferred over Abyssal Mark as it allows Cosette to be on field longer.
• Dark: Mirage is a very good potential to take as the 4th option if used against a single enemy. If used on multiple enemies, it will negatively affect Dark: Afterglow and Dark: Demon Mark's uptime.
• Charge Efficiency from her emblem is only relevant if you have Nether Blaze on your Record.

Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) is the only skill that matters here as it scales the Umbra DMG Taken debuff inflicted based on the level of the skill.

Otoha - Laser Build (5★ Excl.) | 1/1/10/1 (Support Skill only)

57

Otoha's laser build pales in comparison with her skill build when it comes to providing buffs and debuffs. However, what it brings is the ability to be used against bosses that are mobile.

★ Key Notes:
• Solitary Lantern, along with Night-Walker, are the main potentials that enable her to do damage.
• Having a +1 level of Solitary Lantern on your emblem is a big priority for this build as its Ultimate Crit Rate buff gets doubled at Lv 7.
• Devouring Shadow provides a unique DEF PEN buff that requires Otoha to be in an all-Umbra team to work.
• Ensure that her Support Skill is on cooldown before using her Ultimate to take advantage of the buff from Without A Trace.
• Hollow Steps synergizes with Night-Walker and Solitary Lantern as it consistently increase her personal Ultimate Crit Rate and Crit DMG.

Shattered Edge (Support Skill) is the only skill to prioritize for Otoha as Night-Walker's DMG scales based on this skill's level.

Otoha (5★ Excl.) | 1/1/10/1 (Support Skill only)

182

Otoha’s laser build revolves on the Soul Rend effect applied by Weeping Sky. This is a mandatory condition for both Night-Walker’s Doomfall procs and the 80% triple-laser chance from Solitary Lantern.

In contrast to other team comps, this build deals Ultimate DMG (not to be confused with a traditional Ultimate build like Fuyuka).

★ Key Notes:
• Devouring Shadow provides a unique DEF PEN buff that requires Otoha to be in an all-Umbra team to work.
• Do not let her Support Skill miss as this is the only way to inflict Soul Rend to the enemy.
• Try to use her Ultimate while her Support Skill is on cooldown to take advantage of Without A Trace.
• Hollow Steps allows Otoha to frequently do critical hits, synergizing with Cosette's Nightscar Trace potential.
• Having a +1 level of Solitary Lantern on your emblem is a big priority for this build as its Ultimate Crit Rate buff gets doubled at Lv 7.

Shattered Edge (Support Skill) is the only skill to prioritize for Otoha as Night-Walker's DMG scales based on this skill's level.
